caption:
A few days ago we deleted a finished post on the day it was due. A full trend receipt on a rising kitchen category, our best chart of the week. The re-check before publishing showed the score had slipped below the number printed on the cover. Still rising, just no longer that number. We killed it and rebuilt from fresh data. If a slide says today, it has to mean today.

Would you have shipped it with a small gap nobody would catch? Tell us honestly in the comments.

#BuildInPublic #OnlineSellingIndia #DataHonesty #ReceiptsNotHype #DigitalBazaar
